text: Verdict: TEST-FIRST (hypothesis-grade). G1 Aflatoxin B1: AFB1 not measured by HPLC; prior P(fail) = 0.53 [published]. Test a composite of ≥ 10 sub-samples (sampling error often dominates assay error). G5 Food-grade provenance: feed-grade or unknown supply and open or unknown storage: run a micro panel; re-source if possible. The leading chain is moist heat then ae iep, giving an isolate with about 88.5% protein and a 68% chance of meeting your spec. Our cost is about ₹192 per kg protein (a lower bound, because some process costs have no data yet), against ₹518 for imported pea isolate landed in India. The test to buy first is Proximate + Kjeldahl protein, worth about ₹1,60,943 per decision. Decision support only; confirm FSSAI classification.
